notes.title: Summer Update!
notes.content:
Update 1.5.90

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34385259/1f98d72b55ddb0bdc37f77071a9ada2a3a0f58ca.png[/img]

Summer is a time for rest and entertainment! Do you want to tickle your nerves and test them for strength?
Then we give you a 50% discount on the purchase of Creepy Vision now! 

In addition, along with the update you will receive:

- Unlimited number of lives!!!
- Gameplay update.
- Bug fixes.

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: New Update and SALE!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34385259/cf1904daa6ba8b41abbe42296fc5ab3183b14917.png[/img]
Hello!

In touch [b]Orange Valley.[/b]
We are pleased to present to your attention the first major update of our game [b]Creepy Vision.[/b]
Which includes:

- New challenges.
- New locations.
- New enemies. And believe me, they will be very scary! You will need to apply all your skills to win!
- Fix minor bugs.
- And much more!

Get [b]Creepy Vision[b] now or at a [b]50%[/b] discount from Apr 22, 2019 10:00 am Pacific Time (PST)

In addition, it is planned to release the second episode, which you will receive for free!


Are you ready to challenge your fears or will they overcome you?

notes.title: Update 1.4.87 - very soon!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34385259/9be89ddb9ac35d003d62a44e32822e13e58647c7.png[/img]
We get a lot of feedback from you. A large number of reviews and video reviews from players around the world. Thank!

We always listen to your opinion and continue to develop the project.

In this regard, the team is preparing a big update, which will include the following:

- New challenges.
- New locations.
- New enemies. And believe me, they will be very scary!
- Battles with bosses. You will need to apply all your skills to win!
- Subject additions that will allow to understand the identity of the main character.
- Error correction.

And much more!


Regards, Orange Valley!

notes.title: Release!
notes.content:
Hello.

Now [b]Creepy Vsion[/b] is officially available at [b]Steam[/b].

The Orange Valley team continues to work on the project.
And already managed to fix:

- An error with the choice of the Korean Language
- Minor interface fixes
- Improved game balance
- Increased the number of lives at the start of the game

We wish you more positive!

P.S. Do not forget that the game has several endings!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34385259/bb91839d6f4fa061301938ae6939c10660bf069e.png[/img]

notes.title: Release very soon!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34385259/2d3bb20cf9351f0720543cc29aa2a7da81594226.png[/img]Hello!

Before the release of  [b]Creepy Vision[/b]  there is very little time left. We remind you that the PC version of the game will differ significantly from the already released game on Android.

It will include the following:

- Advanced story and secondary quests.
- Non-linear quest system, which is generated for each player individually.
- New locations.
- Redesigned specifically for PC graphics.
- Updated artificial intelligence opponents.
- Updated game interface.
- Steam Achievements.
- And much more.

P.S. You can even shoot a shotgun!

Well, for now you are expecting the release of the game, we suggest you familiarize yourself with the mobile version of [b]Creepy Vision[/b]:

[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.OrangeValley.F20]Google Play[/url]
